messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Emma Rogers <emma.rogers@novahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: NovaHealth – first-week access & project setup

Hi Emma —

Congrats on the contract signing — excited to get NovaHealth live. To make week one smooth I put together a concise access+project setup playbook below. Please confirm the items in bold and drop any missing contacts.

Quick goals for week 1:
- Create NovaHealth org in our console and a staging project for integration tests.
- Provision a short-lived API key for the integration team and set up a service account pattern for production.
- Invite admin and engineering users with least-privilege roles.
- Configure SAML SSO in staging (test only) and plan SCIM group sync if desired.

Action checklist (what we need from NovaHealth):
1) Primary admin email for Redwood console invites (reply with full name + email) — bold: **Confirm primary admin**
2) SAML metadata file or IdP metadata endpoint (XML) — bold: **SAML metadata**
3) IP allowlist for staging connections (CIDR list) — optional but helpful
4) Desired region for hosted inference (us / eu / apac) — bold: **region preference**
5) Any compliance contacts (SOC2/audit) we should copy on evidence requests

What we'll do on our side this week:
- Create the org + staging project and seed an initial API key scoped to test resources.
- Send console invites for admin + two engineer seats.
- Share a short runbook for rotating the initial API key before production cutover.
- Attach a suggested role map and mutual-action plan for review.

Attachments: rishi_initial_checklist.pdf (high-level checklist).

Next steps: if you can reply with items 1–2 by EOD tomorrow (Tue), Marcus will schedule a 30-min integration call for Wed to walk the engineers through the staging key and SSO test.

Thanks — looking forward to working together.

—
Rishi Malhotra
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Thanks Rishi — quick answers below.

Primary admin: Denise Carter (denise.carter@novahealth.com) — she is our cloud admin and will be primary for invites.
SAML: we'll upload metadata but want to confirm whether you prefer metadata XML or an IdP metadata URL. We can provide both.
Region: prefer us (west) for latency.
IP allowlist: we'll provide a small CIDR list but want to confirm the IPs will be the same for staging -> production or if Redwood uses different egress ranges.
Compliance: cc'd security@novahealth.com (they will handle SOC2 evidence requests).

A couple of questions:
- For the initial API key, do you create it in the console and share it with us, or should we create a service principal on our side and exchange credentials?
- For role naming, can you share the least-privilege role names (admin, engineer, billing) so we can map to our internal groups?

Available this week for the integration call: Wed 11:00–13:00 PT.

Best,
Emma
Emma Rogers
IT Lead, NovaHealth
emma.rogers@novahealth.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 11:45:30 -0700
Subject: Re: NovaHealth – first-week access & project setup

Emma — thanks, that's helpful. Short answers and proposed plan below.

1) API key approach:
- We'll create an initial **scoped** API key in the NovaHealth org (staging project) and mark it for immediate rotation before production. This key is intended for onboarding: quick smoke tests and SDK runs.
- For production, we recommend creating a service account model (you can manage keys client-side via your KMS) or a dedicated long-lived service account we create and you rotate on your cadence. Either is fine; we can document both flows.

2) Role names (least-privilege suggestions):
- redwood_admin — full org admin (invite users, billing, rollouts)
- redwood_engineer — deploy/generate keys, view logs, test routes
- redwood_viewer — read-only console access, usage dashboards
- redwood_billing — view/purchase/comms with finance

3) Steps I'll run this week (I'll own these tasks):
- 15 Jun 15:00 PT: create NovaHealth org in staging and a project called nh-staging.
- 15 Jun 15:15 PT: seed initial key (label: nh-onboard-init) and upload role map (attached).
- 16 Jun 09:00 PT: configure SAML in staging with your metadata, run SSO test.
- 17 Jun 10:00 PT: rotate initial key and hand off production key options.

Attachments: NovaHealth_Role_Map.csv, NovaHealth_MAPlan.xlsx (mutual action plan with dates).

If Wednesday 11:00 PT works for you, I'll add a calendar invite and bring a short demo of the SDK and permission checks.

—
Marcus Lin
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Emma — great, thanks for the fast turnaround.

We prefer the IdP metadata URL for automated refresh, but the XML is fine as well. If you can drop the URL in a reply or upload the XML to the shared folder (link below), Marcus will get SAML configured in staging tomorrow morning.

On IPs: Redwood uses a small set of egress ranges by region; staging will use the same egress set as production in us-west. I'll paste exact CIDRs in a follow-up from Dev (he manages network policy).

Proposed integration call: Wed 17 Jun 2026, 11:00 PT — Marcus to run the demo, Monica to confirm invite list, Dev will be on the line for the IP/SSO portion. Calendar invite to follow.

Shared upload link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1X-ExampleOnboarding

Thanks — Rishi
